description: List the jobs in Priors' catalogue that any agent's AI can do for a client and sell (the jobs of Go mode > Jobs, with no Go mode account needed): what the client gets, each paid tool it uses with its host and price, what a run and a month of tools cost, the loan that covers them if the agent's wallet is short, and whether it is Live now (every tool passed a paid test and the run fits a setup's limits) or Coming next, and why. Filter by kind or by a word; with agent_id, also whether that agent's Priors line has room for each job's loan. job_brief gives one job's brief for the agent's AI. Read-only.

agent_id.description: Optional: the agent that would do the work, to say whether its Priors line has room for each job's loan.

kind.description: One kind of job: agents, a2a, ai, web, code, chain, media, biz. Omit for all.

query.description: A word to look for in the job, its tools, hosts or sellers, e.g. translate.

status.description: live (the default): the jobs an agent can take now; next: the ones Coming next; both.

name: find_jobs
title: Find jobs an agent can do and sell
